prompt: What will the remaining players check in the courtyard?
promptZh: 留下來的團員會在庭院確認什麼？

options.text: Which bells need to be replaced.
The start time for the next rehearsal.
options.whyZh: 只說明今天六點後的安排，沒有談下次。

options.text: How many new players can join.
options.zh: 可以招募多少位新團員。
options.whyZh: 安排給現有團員，沒有談招募。

options.zh: 最後的和弦聽起來如何。
options.whyZh: 六點後，留到最後的團員到戶外聽最後幾個音一起奏出的聲音，也就是最後的和弦。

explanationZh: 六點後，留到最後的團員到戶外聽最後幾個音一起奏出的聲音，也就是最後的和弦。
evidence: No ringing indoors today. We can practice the hand movements without bells. The courtyard is free after six if we want to hear the actual notes. / Start with that change upstairs. After six, I’ll take the remaining players outside to hear how the last notes sound together.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
